Translations.Text: Con presencia en todos los rincones del aeropuerto, Gatsby ofrece gran variedad de sándwiches y ensaladas, coronado con un excelente buffet que complace los gustos de toda la familia. Además, su cafetería de nivel te brinda un espacio de calma en cada visita.

With a presence in every corner of the airport, Gatsby offers a variety of sandwiches and salads, crowned by an excellent buffet that pleases all tastes in the family. Its high-level coffee shop also offers you a peaceful atmosphere every time you visit.
